parameters.jsCode: const built=$('Build Story Breakdown Trace').first().json,response=$input.first().json;const status=Number(response.statusCode??200),partial=response.body?.partialSuccess??response.partialSuccess??null,rejected=Number(partial?.rejectedSpans??0);if(status<200||status>=300||rejected>0)throw new Error('Langfuse trace ingestion rejected: HTTP '+status+' rejectedSpans='+rejected+' message='+(partial?.errorMessage||''));const {otlp_payload,...clean}=built;return [{json:{...clean,observability:{...(clean.observability||{}),ingestion_accepted:true,ingestion_status_code:status,rejected_spans:rejected,semantic_observation:'story-breakdown-semantic-evaluation',environment:'production-agreement-shadow'}}}];
